description: pnpm: pnpm-lock.yaml v9 — only the packages: section becomes components. The snapshots: section repeats those exact keys with the peer set each was resolved against appended, and must contribute NOTHING: a leaked snapshots key would emit a component whose version reads 2.1.4(left-pad@1.3.0), which is the silent-wrong-answer this case exists to pin. importers: (the workspace's own members, including a link: devDependency) is first-party and also silent. The tarball-only entry resolves with no integrity — a URL where the version belongs — so it is skipped with a counted warning, and that count is behind the exit 1
